children: Hong Kong port operator's H1 revenue rose 12.3% yr/yr on higher throughput and rate hikes
Net profit attributable to equity holders up 28.5% yr/yr, driven by gains at key terminals
Company will continue to optimise its global terminal network resource allocation
THROUGHPUT GROWTH - Co said higher overall throughput, especially at newly commissioned and key terminals, drove revenue and profit increases
RATE HIKES - Co said rate hikes at terminals including Piraeus and Tianjin contributed to revenue growth
PROVISION REVERSAL - Co said reversal of a prior provision boosted other operating income
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 3 "strong buy" or "buy", 3 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the marine port services peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for COSCO SHIPPING Ports Ltd is HK$5.68, about 8.7% above its August 27 closing price of HK$5.23
The stock recently traded at 8 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 8 three months ago
